title: Circles
intro: Small, private groups of close friends or classmates. Nothing is shared until you choose to share it.
emptyText: A circle is a few friends who can see each other showing up. Start one, then invite them with a link.
loadFailedText: Check your connection and try again.

new.title: Start a circle
new.description: Give it a name your friends will recognise.
new.label: Circle name

circle.notFoundText: It may have been closed, or you are no longer in it.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.description: Anyone with this link can join until it stops working. That is in 7 days, or as soon as you make a new link.

join.title: Join {name}?
join.text: {count, plural, one {# person is} other {# people are}} in this circle.
join.invalidText: It has expired, or a newer link replaced it. Ask for a new one.
join.full: This circle is full, so no one else can join right now.

confirm.leaveText: What you shared there goes with you. You can be invited back.
confirm.closeText: This removes the circle for everyone in it. It cannot be undone.
confirm.removeText: They leave the circle, and what they shared there is removed.
